attribution.ownership: Derivative of public641; original author/source preserved.

mechanism: One helper and one pc_run1c call replacement. Preserve original head offer, probe one older hint plus a second only when original dp>=2, using unchanged pc_probe_lazy/window/byte checks. Choose strict greater original pc_gain, retaining head then nearer predecessor on ties. Final existing comparison against current match remains unchanged.
cost: Every actual chain lazy iteration adds one prev read; each live strictly older hint adds one source word and an original lazy validation, which can extend to258. dp>=2 may add a second of each. No new persistent arrays, hashing, insertion, postpass or route. Runtime cost remains UNKNOWN.
preserved: All route/classifier/H/hash/normal-chain/record/fold/emitter code and existing near-distance guards; no A3/A5/A6/A7 combination.
